name: WebMon
tagline: Interactive Web Component Picker, Tabbed Main/Header/Footer Builder, 100-Item Telemetry Cards, Undo & Copy Widget, Visual + Code JSON/XML Mapper & Cross-Device iCloud Sync
short_description: Native macOS, iOS/iPadOS & Windows 11 interactive web browser, visual DOM component selector, and Visual + Code JSON/XML Data Mapper that pins any website element or JSON/XML API path as a resizable floating desktop widget or iPhone/iPad Home & Lock Screen widget with tabbed Main DOM / Header / Footer customization, up to 100 data items per card, 1-click Undo & Copy Widget, Reopen DOM Chooser to update existing widgets, 10 font families, 12 adaptive telemetry card styles, Sign in with Apple iCloud sync, live cadence auto-refresh, and local Keychain credential vault.
spotlight_description: WebMon v2.3.0 (Build 41) introduces full-card scrollbar-free item expansion across all 12 telemetry card styles on macOS and iOS (cards fill 100% of available card height without rolling up items into scroll boxes), tabbed Main DOM / Header / Footer component customization (link any captured DOM section or add custom tokens directly into your widget header or footer), configurable DOM Refresh Settle Wait Time (0–30s, default 12s) across both macOS and iOS (Widget Editor, Browser Picker, Widget Cards & Settings), multi-step Undo when editing widgets, support for up to 100 data items per card (plus extra visible/hidden items in prescribed card styles while retaining DOM configuration), 1-click Reopen DOM Chooser at URL to append new elements and Update Widget in place, full Copy Widget duplication (preserving config, auth, and refresh cadence with a required new name prompt), and 6 additional font families (Avenir, Futura, Helvetica Neue, Menlo, Georgia, Chalkboard SE). Open any HTML webpage, JSON API endpoint, or XML/RSS feed in the built-in WebKit browser: select DOM components or use the Visual Field Tree + Code/Path Query Editor, customize every zone, and pin them as resizable Liquid Glass desktop widgets or iPhone/iPad Home, Lock Screen & ExtraLarge widgets that refresh automatically on your custom cadence (5s to 60m).
catalog_description: Native macOS, iOS & iPadOS WebKit component clipper, Visual + Code JSON & XML Structured Data Mapper, 12-style adaptive telemetry card engine, smart data dissolver, resizable floating desktop & Home/Lock Screen widget suite, live cadence refresh scheduler, Sign in with Apple cross-device iCloud sync, and local Keychain credential vault engineered in Swift 6. Features an interactive DOM element picker with scroll-anchored bounding-box overlays, automatic in-browser JSON/XML card formatting with visual tree + path query builder, Static Text / Environment Variable / Date-Time token items with per-item typography controls, Header & Cross-Icon drag anchors, toggleable Header & Footer chrome with 100% full-card edge-to-edge bleed, custom Solid/Gradient/Wallpaper widget backgrounds, pan & zoom viewport framing, and Low Effort Suite theme & icon sync.
